title: Goodbye, Swift! A space telescope falls to Earth
lead: After 22 years in space, NASA's Swift telescope has come back to Earth and burned up in the sky.
body: On Wednesday 4 November 2026, an old NASA space telescope called Swift fell back to Earth. Most of it burned up in the sky over Indonesia. This was the end of a very long mission: Swift spent 22 years in space!

Swift went into space in 2004. Its engineers designed it for only 2 years, but it has worked for more than 10 times longer. Its job was to watch gamma-ray bursts, the most powerful explosions in the universe. When a burst happened, Swift turned very quickly to observe it.
During its long life, Swift spotted more than 2,000 of these bursts and more than 1,400 exploding stars. Scientists have used its data in about 7,000 studies.

But Swift slowly lost height, because the thin air at the top of our atmosphere slowed it down. In 2026, NASA tried to rescue it with a robot spacecraft, but the robot broke down, so the plan failed. Swift's mission is over now, but its discoveries will help scientists for many years.

questions.q: How long did the engineers plan Swift's mission to last?
Where did Swift fall back to Earth?
What happened to the robot spacecraft?
options: It brought Swift back to the USA
